get_data: read a JSON file of DFT and force field data and extract CO2 and H2O interaction energies and errors
binned_average: compute the average prediction error within each bin of DFT adsorption energy values
get_Fig4a: generate a histogram comparing raw force field minus DFT error distributions for CO2 and H2O
get_Fig4b: create a binned average error bar plot with KDE density overlay for CO2 and H2O interaction energies
phys_err: calculate the mean absolute error for physisorption data points where DFT energy is between 0 and -0.5 eV
